identifier.value: Duty and Tax Calculation at Checkout

product.name: Duty and Tax Calculation at Checkout
product.description: Calculates and displays the full landed cost including duties, VAT, and taxes at checkout to prevent hidden fees and customs surprises.

product.name: Local Payment Methods Integration
product.description: Enables acceptance of region-specific payment methods in over 100 countries to accommodate local customer preferences.

product.name: Storefront Localization
product.description: Automatically translates and localizes online store content into over 55 languages, including regional dialects and cultural nuances.

product.name: Global Expansion Onboarding and Configuration
product.description: Guides merchants through account setup, payment configuration, tax and duty settings, and storefront localization to enable international sales.

product.name: Discounted Shipping and Local Warehousing
product.description: Offers discounted international shipping rates and access to local warehouses to reduce delivery times and costs for global orders.

product.name: Marketing and Creative Support
product.description: Provides localized marketing creatives, managed advertising spend, and dedicated marketing management to support global sales growth.
